visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a top-down view of a black square lunch box sitting on a light wood grain surface. Inside the box, a bed of white rice is decorated with nine small pinches of bright green garnish, making it look like a simple, plain meal. Large, pink-bordered text overlays the top and bottom of the frame. (2) A young woman with brown hair and bangs, wearing a soft pink cable-knit sweater, is seated at a table indoors. She looks down at her smartphone with a disappointed or contemplative expression. Floating chat bubble graphics appear on the left, simulating a messaging conversation. The lighting is soft and warm, suggesting an indoor living space. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of hands holding a packaged lunch box. The label reveals the brand "争鲜gogo" (Sushi Express gogo). The woman flips the box over, and her facial expression changes from confusion to surprise. The camera zooms in as she pulls back the bottom label. (4) A rapid montage follows, showcasing the actual contents of the lunch box which were hidden underneath the rice: one version contains slices of seasoned pork and shrimp, while another features chunks of salmon and imitation crab. The food is vibrantly colored and appears fresh under bright studio-style lighting. (5) The woman is now seen standing in front of a brightly lit "争鲜gogo" retail outlet. She holds two lunch boxes towards the camera, smiling broadly. Promotional text about a "White Valentine's Day" special and a "Buy 2 get 2 free drinks" offer appears on the screen. (6) Close-up shots demonstrate the peeling of a sticker on the packaging to reveal a prize or lottery result. The editing is fast-paced with various colorful graphic transitions emphasizing the "hidden surprise" theme.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat, high-tempo synth BGM. A young female voice expresses disbelief, remarking that her Valentine's meal is just white rice. (2) A sharp 'ding' notification sound occurs as message bubbles appear visually. Her voice is soft and slightly muffled, mimicking a casual vlog tone. (3) A male narrator with a bright, professional broadcasting voice abruptly enters. He speaks with high energy and rapid articulation, describing the brand 'Sushi Express gogo'. The BGM continues with a driving electronic beat. (4) A crisp rustling sound is heard as a plastic label is peeled back. The male narrator explains the hidden ingredients, his voice synchronized with the fast visual cuts. (5) A 'pop' SFX accompanies the reveal of a prize ticket. The narrator increases his pitch variability to denote excitement. (6) The video concludes with both voices enthusiastically encouraging the audience to visit the store, ending with a rhythmic musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Reveal -> Product Showcase -> Promo Details -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional advertisement for the 'Hidden Surprise' lunch box campaign at Sushi Express gogo. It uses a comedic hook where a character feels disappointed by a plain rice meal, only to reveal premium ingredients hidden underneath. The intent is to generate curiosity and drive customers to the store for a limited-time White Valentine's Day promotion.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct mention of the brand, display of products, and detailed promotional offer with dates and store locations.
